arguments.where_clause: merchant_location_id IN (SELECT id FROM merchant_locations WHERE city = 'Rome' AND state = 'Italy')
arguments.explanation: Flags every transaction whose merchant location is in Rome, Italy, matching the city and state together.
assumptions: City and state are matched exactly as written: city 'Rome' and state 'Italy', case-sensitive, as stored in merchant_locations.
The location is matched through transactions.merchant_location_id, not merchant_id, so only the transaction's own location counts.
Rome, Georgia (GA) and Rome, New York (NY) are excluded because the state must be 'Italy'.
